purpose: Choose source-backed prompt techniques for a new brief without inheriting the source brand, timing, music, engine or tool permissions.
workflow: Filter the index by content_tags, then choose two or three entries with different approaches that fit the brief.
Read only those rows from prompt_data; line numbers in this index are one-based. Record the page_url and source_links in production.json.
Extract a useful decision: story structure, state list, type motion, camera, or audio cue. Replace names, claims, assets and defaults with the actual brief.
Browse the entry page or video when a visual judgment needs it. Mark linked, retrieved and inspected media separately.
Check the coverage manifest before claiming an exhaustive snapshot. Browse the live site for newly added entries or missing context; this is a dated archive.

teaching.notice: Repeated showreel prompts occur across unrelated projects.
teaching.why: A repeated setup test supplies a genre but does not supply the product story.
teaching.test: Can each selected technique be tied to this brief and an exact source entry, without copying its brand or asserting that its linked video was inspected?
teaching.bad: Reuse the same showreel prompt and default music for a calm product loop; claim the catalog video was watched.
teaching.good: Select a UI morph and a typography entry, cite both pages, adapt only their state and text timing to the supplied product and track.
teaching.exception: A requested reproduction or setup diagnostic may keep the source prompt; it still grants no asset license or tool authority.

recovery: If an entry is missing or its media cannot be retrieved, retain its source URL and label the gap. Use another inspected reference or request essential material; do not invent visual detail.

freedom.selection: high; choose styles from brief evidence
freedom.adaptation: medium; preserve a useful pattern while honoring pinned user choices
freedom.coverage: low; compare every catalog entry and prompt digest
